Ethical Hacking · Years 9–10

Learn to hack.
The right way.

Real cybersecurity isn't memorising tools — it's a way of thinking: how systems work, where they break, and how to defend them. You'll work through 24 hands-on labs in a safe sandbox, from your first terminal command to breaking (and fixing) a live web app.

Ethics firstTerminalCryptoWeb attacksForensicsCapture the flag
Unauthorised access to computer systems is a criminal offence (in Australia, under the Criminal Code Act 1995 — Part 10.7). This range teaches you to be the good guy. Progress saves automatically in your browser.
